matches.evidence: fr.wikipedia Championnat de France de football 2000-2001: le résultat du match ASSE-TFC (1-0 sur le terrain) a été donné gagnant pour Toulouse sur tapis vert sur le score de 0-0. The official table counts a Toulouse win with no goals.
matches.note: Following the false passports affair, the result of the ASSE-TFC match (1–0 on the field) was given the winner for Toulouse on the green carpet with a score of 0–0 by the Council of State on 25 June 2001. However, the LFP website does not seem up to date on this point.

Following the false passports affair, victory was awarded for Rennes 2–0 (2–2 on the pitch). Final result since 28 June 2001 (confirmed by the FFF and not contested by FC Metz before administrative justice).
